messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 PAGING: high error rate detected on inference-hotpath (gpu-pool-east-1). Alert: sustained queue growth + >10% 429 rate over 5m. Oncall: @Jamie.
Jamie (oncall): ACK. I'm on it, grabbing metrics and logs.
Maya (sre): I can see a steep queue bump at 22:03 UTC, token-bucket refill on tier=standard dropped to 0.2 rps after the last policy push. 429s spiking from 0% -> ~12%.
Nik (eng-runtime): oof, that refill change was part of the tier-slim optimization yesterday. We rolled the config via infra-config v2026.03.14. Did autoscaler try to spin more GPUs?
Maya (sre): autoscaler attempted scale but hit pool upper bounds: pool hotpath-east max=8, current nodes=8, queue kept growing. Autoscaler logs show "scale request throttled: pool quota reached".
Jamie (oncall): timeline: 22:00 config push -> 22:02 token ref lowered -> 22:03 queue growth -> 22:05 429s >10% -> page.
Lee (support): We're seeing ~22 open support errors flagged by NLU: failed requests from customers: acme-inc, globex, datapoint-co. Opening incident tickets.
Nik (eng-runtime): I can temporarily bump the token bucket refill for tier=standard and bump burst. Proposing: refill 600 rps, burst 3000 (was 120/800). Doing a quick patch:```bash
infra-configctl set-tier --name=standard --refill=600 --burst=3000 --reason="emergency mitigation 1917002468"
```
deploy-bot: autoscaler: manual scale request received from Jamie -> target_nodes=10. Current nodes=8. Request queued for approval due to quota.
Jamie (oncall): I'm requesting emergency capacity increase with infra. @Nik please hold on the token change until I confirm autoscale action, we want to avoid token storm.
Maya (sre): metrics: while we wait, we can route non-SLA traffic to the slower fallback model. Adding a route rule to route heavy, non-enterprise traffic to model=redwood-small-v1.
Nik (eng-runtime): Done. Route update applied:```json
{ "route": "fallback-non-sla", "target_model": "redwood-small-v1", "percent": 50 }
```
Maya (sre): Confirming 50% of non-SLA requests shifted. That reduced observed ingress by ~18% within 60s. Queue rate down slightly but 429s still present for enterprise tier.
Jamie (oncall): Infra says quota increase will take ~7m. We should still tune token-bucket to reduce immediate 429s for enterprise. Nik, please apply the token patch and keep logs open.
Nik (eng-runtime): Applying the token change now. Will monitor.
Nik (eng-runtime): PATCH applied. Token refill -> 600 rps, burst -> 3000. Watch logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/hotpath/*.log | grep "429" | wc -l`
Maya (sre): Within 90s 429s fallen from 12% -> 2.5%. Queue length back to baseline over 3m. Autoscaler response still pending.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: quota increase approved by infra-admin. Scaling hotpath-east from 8 -> 12 nodes. Estimated time to ready: ~3m.
Jamie (oncall): Nice. Keep the token changes; record as emergency override. Nik make a small PR to revert once we stabilise.
Lee (support): Noted. I'll send interim comms to affected customers: short apology + mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery.
Ash (pm): Which customers were impacted and how many requests failed? Need numbers for the postmortem.
Maya (sre): Initial estimate: 12% 429s across the hotpath during the ~10m spike. Affected users concentrated in 7 orgs (ACME, Globex, Datapoint, NovaAI, BrightPay, Finalpha, EduStream). Roughly 1.2k failed requests total.
Jamie (oncall): Logging timeline and actions to incident doc: https://internal/redwood/incidents/1917002468 (placeholder).
Nik (eng-runtime): Followups: 1) revert last policy push that reduced refill. 2) add safe-guard to prevent tier config from dropping below min-refill. 3) add autoscaler alert for "scale request denied for quota". I'll open PRs.
Maya (sre): Post-incident tasks from SRE: confirm token-bucket limits per tier, add alert for >5% 429 sustained for 3m, run a chaos test for pool-quota edge-case.
Jamie (oncall): Handing off to Maya for post-incident monitoring and to Nik for config PRs. I'll stay on for comms until Ash confirms support messages.
Ash (pm): I'll draft a short customer notice and coordinate with legal. Will share draft in #marketing after it lands.
Lee (support): All affected customers have tickets with mitigation notes and ETA. We'll update as we have more.
Maya (sre): Current status: service stable, 429s <1%, queue normal, extra nodes coming up. Closing paging, switching to post-incident triage.
incident-bot: Incident status set to: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: S2.
Jamie (oncall): ACK. Thank you team — nice triage. Starting postmortem doc and will include timeline + root cause: improper tier refill change + pool quota limits.
Nik (eng-runtime): I'll push the revert PR now and include automated guard.
Ash (pm): Action items: customer comms, revert + guard, autoscaler quota escalation playbook, postmortem in 48h.
Lee (support): Closing thread from support side once comms are posted.
Jamie (oncall): Handing off: @Maya lead postmortem, @Nik config fixes, @Ash comms. I'm done on-call for this page.
Maya (sre): Acknowledged. Will own.
